purpose: Static materialisation of CHG-050 rendering obligations and structural obligation descriptors. No rendering function, projection, engine, or independent review is implemented.
inputModel: Rendering inputs are semantic projections of supplied unit text/kind/role/generation/grouping/licensing facts. unitFacts and unitTexts are NOT public contract fields or complete schema-valid API forms; missing syllables, spans and provenance are deliberately not invented. A later authorised renderer test must instantiate full public fixtures from verified sources.
expectedTextPolicy: Exact packet outputs or explicitly labelled direct presentation-rule derivations only. Synthetic code-unit inputs do not claim any linguistic mapping or attested spelling.
utf16Policy: JSON uses escapes for non-ASCII and lone surrogates. utf16beCodeUnitsHex describes literal expected UTF-16 code units only, not canonical bytes or a new canonical encoder.

structuralObligations.runtimeOnlyScalarNote: Labels designate actual non-finite runtime numbers to instantiate in a test harness; they are not valid public string replacements.

rejectReferenceConditions: strictly decreasing or reordered resolved positions
id resolving to more than one unit
fractional, negative, non-finite or unsafe memory index
non-person outer Entity holding styled form
memory unitIds / source id or span

reject: verbatim English with person or styleApplicable
romanisation formKind with any literal/translated unit
hybrid formKind without both romanised and literal/translated kinds
preserve: assembled English person and non-person branches

structuralObligations.note: ProtectedSpan.styleApplied nullability follows its original contract; this obligation narrows only non-null style values. No global givenNameJoin default is introduced.

requiredEvidence: identical ordered UTF-16 code-unit outputs per case and requested profile
identical result-string bytes under the unchanged accepted §5.15.2 string encoding
renderVariants length, order and duplicate multiplicity preserved before per-string comparison
crossRuntimeObligation.canonicalEncoder: reuse accepted encoder unchanged; no new encoder in this directory
